summary: Part 1 of 2 (00:00-03:55) of the KAM training on the Fulfillment App backend. The trainer says the Fulfillment App is a frontend with some features over a backend Google Sheet (Fulfillment App - O&D) where the data is stored. He walks the Requests, Request_products, Inventory, Inventory_movements, box_movements and Users tabs, and traces one Smart Reach shipment (Request ID f1f9de7f; he says 23 devices have been requested; three SKU lines) from the sheet to the app. He says usually you are not supposed to input any data in these tabs or in the Fulfillment app, that the app is there to help monitor suppliers, and near the end he edits his own Users row (row 2) to the SteppingStone seller values and says he has taken that account. All 40 frames listed in the pack were opened. Several spoken words were corrected from the screen (REBIL to AWB, Revive to Revibe, smart search to Smart Reach). Unclear items: the RTO and cancelled types, the restart step, the Score, Inventory days, Open/Closed and Payment method columns, which quantity the 23 refers to, and the trainer editing a Users row while describing the seller view.

privacy.what: Requests tab shows Created by and Updated by values that are individual seller and staff e-mail addresses (Gmail and seller-domain addresses) next to supplier names. Do not show these to sellers without redaction.
Shipments page shows Created by e-mail addresses of individual sellers (for example the Smart Reach account), next to tracking IDs.
Request_products tab shows Created by and Updated by e-mail addresses of sellers and staff on each SKU line (truncated on screen).
Inventory_movements tab shows IMEI numbers, Order help numbers and Request tracking IDs for individual devices, linked to seller supplier names.
box_movements tab shows Seller names and Required by e-mail addresses of individual sellers and staff (t00187.jpg). The Sent at and Sent by columns are empty in the visible rows.
Users tab lists names and e-mail addresses of Revibe staff and individual supplier contacts (Name and Email columns, rows 1 to 50), plus Initials and Status. Do not show this sheet to sellers.
